purpose: Explicit ledger of skill identities found during enumeration that are not promoted to canonical records because Xenoverse 2-specific class/subcategory evidence is insufficient or conflicting.
rules: Do not invent class/subcategory, Ki cost, acquisition, DLC, CaC availability, or Ultimate Finish requirements.
A gap may be promoted only after Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes the required field(s).
Historical or cross-game evidence is retained as corroboration, not treated as current Xenoverse 2 proof.

gaps.name: Acid
gaps.known_identity: Cast-exclusive Super used by Saibaman variants
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Acid ID 140, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Saibaman; it separately lists raid-boss Acid as ID 143.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact lists Acid at IDs 140 and 143 under Super Skills.
The Xenoverse 2 Saibaman page lists Acid on Saibaman 2.
A dated Xenoverse 2 community discussion identifies Acid in the Saibaman 2 raid moveset.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Acid as a CaC-unavailable Super Skill used by Saibaman variants. The documented normal ID 140 and separate raid-boss ID 143 are distinct; there is no validated CaC unlock/acquisition route. Only the canonical numeric Ki cost remains unverified.

gaps.name: Howl
gaps.known_identity: Great Ape-exclusive skill used by Great Ape enemies
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Howl ID 10440, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Great Ape.
Great Ape Festival lists Howl on Great Ape Nappa, Vegeta, and Bardock.
Saiyan Survivors lists Howl on Great Ape Nappa and Vegeta.
Power x10 x2? Great Ape Transformation lists Howl on Great Ape Nappa and Vegeta.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Howl as a CaC-unavailable Evasive Skill used by Great Ape enemies across multiple encounters. No CaC unlock/acquisition route exists in the documented evidence; only the canonical numeric Ki cost remains unverified.

gaps.name: Boiling Burg
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 540 to Boiling Burg, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its user.
Xenoverse 2 Legend Patrol evidence lists Boiling Burg in Final Form Demigra's moveset.
Xenoverse 2-specific CaC-unobtainable skill catalog independently lists Boiling Burg.
Xenoverse 2 Demigra reference material describes Boiling Burg as Final Demigra's Ultimate attack and its in-game behavior.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes Boiling Burg as a CaC-unavailable Ultimate used by Final Form Demigra. The canonical Ki-cost field remains unverified; no numeric cost is inferred from other games or mod data. Current verification reconfirms its Final Form Demigra Ultimate identity and CaC-unavailable boundary; Ki cost remains unresolved.

gaps.name: Energy Boil
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 10540 to Energy Boil, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its source.
A Xenoverse 2 Demigra restoration/mod artifact explicitly describes Energy Boil as functioning as an evasive for Final Form Demigra.
A Dragon Ball reference independently identifies Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill and describes its energy/teleport/ki-gathering behavior.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes the Evasive classification and CaC restriction, but the repository's canonical subcategory and Ki-cost fields remain unverified. Current verification reconfirms its Final Form Demigra Evasive identity and CaC-unavailable boundary; subtype and Ki cost remain unresolved.

gaps.name: Baked Sphere
evidence: Xenoverse 2 character ID list identifies Baked Sphere as skill ID 531 and CaC-unavailable.
Xenoverse 2-specific Future Warrior documentation identifies Baked Sphere as the Masked Future Warrior's Ultimate Skill and a Crystal Raid Supervillain-state skill.
Xenoverse 2 community catalog explicitly lists Baked Sphere among skills unobtainable by CaC.
Xenoverse 2 gameplay documentation and character move lists place Baked Sphere in Supervillain-controlled character movesets.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Baked Sphere as a CaC-unavailable Ultimate associated with Supervillain/Masked Future Warrior usage. Current technique taxonomy supports Explosive Wave as the research subcategory. Only the canonical numeric Ki cost remains unverified.

gaps.name: Boulder Toss
gaps.known_identity: Great Ape-exclusive Super Skill used by Great Ape enemies
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Boulder Toss skill ID 441, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Great Ape as its source.
Xenoverse 2 PQ and Expert Mission tables repeatedly list Boulder Toss on Great Ape Nappa and/or Great Ape Vegeta.
Xenoverse 2-specific reference material identifies Boulder Toss as a Super Skill used by Great Apes.
Repository batch 286 reconciles the earlier Other placeholder to Strike using current Xenoverse 2 Great Ape quest documentation.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Boulder Toss as a CaC-unavailable Super Skill used by Great Ape Nappa/Vegeta, and repository batch 286 supports the canonical Strike subtype. Only the numeric Ki cost remains unverified; canonical integration still awaits the supported builder/runtime.

gaps.name: Boiling Ball
gaps.known_identity: Demon God Demigra (Final Form) Super Skill (Ki Blast subtype), CaC-unavailable
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 541 to Boiling Ball, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its source.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact places Boiling Ball in the Super Skills section.
Legend Patrol's Defend History! Unknown Battle lists Boiling Ball on Final Form Demigra.
Xenoverse 2 Demigra reference material describes the move's three spinning dark-energy spheres and its Time Rift behavior.
A Xenoverse 2 catalog of skills unobtainable by CaC lists Boiling Ball.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Boiling Ball as a CaC-unavailable Super Skill used by Final Form Demigra. The repository subtype and canonical Ki-cost fields remain unverified. Repository research batch 289 already records the Xenoverse 2 subtype as Ki Blast; this subtype is retained as research-backed taxonomy, while numeric Ki cost remains unverified.
